title: STAR: Steering Action Representations during Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.41009v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) map language instructions and visual observations to robot actions, showing strong capabilities across robotic manipulation tasks. However, in our probing experiment, we find that action representations near the action output do not fully preserve task-relevant visual grounding. Motivated by this late-layer grounding gap, we introduce STAR, for STeering Action Representations, a training-free inference method for pre-trained VLAs. STAR applies an exponential moving average over late-layer residual updates, allowing later action representations to inherit object-aware update directions from earlier layers without model updates or architectural changes. It further uses recent proprioceptive states to adapt the mixing strength, using conservative mixing when execution dynamics change rapidly. translated_title: STAR：在推理过程中引导动作表示
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）将语言指令和视觉观察映射为机器人动作，在各种机器人操作任务中展现出强大的能力。然而，在我们的探测实验中，我们发现靠近动作输出的动作表示并未完全保留与任务相关的视觉接地信息。受这一深层接地缺口的启发，我们提出了STAR（STeering Action Representations，引导动作表示），这是一种面向预训练VLA模型的无训练推理方法。STAR对后层残差更新应用指数移动平均，使后期的动作表示能够从早期层继承对象感知的更新方向，而无需更新模型或更改架构。它还利用近期的本体感觉状态来自适应地调整混合强度，在执行动力学快速变化时采用保守的混合策略。在机器人操作基准上的实验表明，STAR提高了后层的对象感知能力，并提升了……
tldr: STAR是一种无需训练的推理方法，通过对后层残差更新应用指数移动平均，让预训练视觉-语言-动作模型的后期动作表示继承早期层的对象感知方向，从而提升机器人操作任务中的视觉接地能力。
